fusions.name: Road's-End Stamp
fusions.desc: A stamp that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +40%).

fusions.name: Overtaken at Last
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A plodding blow that deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.4 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Rest at the Milestone
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and heals you for 10 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Every League Hardens
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, your shell hardens into a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
